counterfactual.change: actuated true->false; fixed-time cycle then rotates normally and no max_wait violation in same 571 steps

explanation: NS green starts ~step 378 and is still NS green at step 571 (~193s), far exceeding max_green_seconds 45. Under actuated control with S demand persistent and N detector failed, the controller never gap-outs/recalls and fails to enforce max-green, starving EW (E/W red waits grow 55 at step 425 to 195 at 565 to 201 at 571) causing max_wait violation. Fixed-time version of identical scenario shows no violation.

violation.detail: approach 1 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: The east and west entries show long stationary blue queues with red stopped vehicles persisting unchanged across steps 568 to 571, while the north-south entries show only single vehicles. Nothing moves through the intersection over the four frames, indicating one direction is holding green indefinitely and starving the cross street.
